source.note: The full network type derives Serialize/Deserialize; NetworkStateSnapshot is a transient Debug/Clone/Default buffer.

EvolutionSnapshot.allowed_use: restore evolution state against the same immutable model/parameter generation

LearnerCheckpoint.allowed_use: resume dynamics and learning under the declared runtime contract

ReplayCheckpoint.allowed_use: restore a complete learner and continue/replay from the declared event boundary

WeightsOnlyArtifact.allowed_use: initialize or transfer a model under an explicit non-resumable load contract

mandatory_negative_controls: EvolutionSnapshot must not qualify as LearnerCheckpoint.
Missing momentum must fail training-continuation parity even if the immediate forward output matches.
Wrong parameter-generation digest paired with an EvolutionSnapshot must be rejected.
WeightsOnlyArtifact must not claim optimizer or dynamic-state continuity.
A field omitted from a serialized checkpoint must be visible in the artifact-class completeness declaration.
nonclaims: This inventory is derived from source declarations, not a measured checkpoint size.
It does not prove the full Serialize/Deserialize representation is a stable durable wire format.
It does not prove the current HME stores any of these artifacts.
Field mutability classifications require further source/call-site audit before compression or split-segment design.
The Bridge field classification is a source audit; it does not prove that fields are currently durably persisted.

bridge_type.name: HdcLtcBridge

fields.details: Must carry the complete LearnerCheckpoint field set; not just NetworkStateSnapshot.
Includes input/output dimensions, HDC dimension, architecture, activation, adaptive resize policy and initialization seed.
Observed read-only in project_to_hdc/project_to_hdc_vec and reinitialized on resize; preserve exact values or versioned PRNG/GenesisSeed regeneration lineage.
Read by project_from_hdc and mutated in train_step by rank-one outer-product gradient; preserve dense values or exact ordered factor updates.
Either persist or recompute and independently verify against the declared projection/output contract.
Persist or recompute under a versioned exact policy; do not silently reset if externally observed.
Affects when the next adaptive resize may occur.
Optional GenesisSeed used to reinitialize projections/network after resize.

bridge_checkpoint_required_classes: bridge config and current HDC dimension
input projection exact bytes or deterministic regeneration profile+seed+algorithm version
output projection dense bytes or exact update-factor representation
current output/cache and counters under explicit persist-or-recompute verification contract
adaptive resize cooldown and deterministic initialization lineage
source commit/profile and projection algorithm version
observed_source_behavior: HdcLtcBridge derives Debug + Clone rather than Serialize/Deserialize.
The input projection is initialized in new/from_genesis and rebuilt in maybe_resize; no writer was found in inspected source paths outside construction/resize.
The output projection is initialized in new/from_genesis, rebuilt in maybe_resize, read in project_from_hdc and updated in train_step by an outer-product gradient.
maybe_resize rebuilds the inner network and projection matrices rather than converting the full learner state; state-continuity must be qualified separately under #6560/#6561/#7749.
